summary: Regression + new-feature testing of the redesigned AIRBCARS booking flow. All 11 backend pytest tests PASS, including the new /api/car-price short-term supplement logic (3-day rental → +40% supplement = 147€ total on car 313; 5-day rental → no supplement, base==total) and the real CSRF+session upstream booking flow which now returns success:true with booking_number + pin_code (verified booking ABC734805, PIN 023099 created during test). 422 validation on missing required fields also works. Frontend booking flow (/booking/313) works end-to-end on mobile viewport: name inputs, WhatsApp with +212 default country-code chips, pickup/return date pickers, min 3-day rental notice, pickup city chips, cash payment, live price breakdown (35€/day × 3 = 105 + 40% short-term fee 42 = 147€ total), Confirm Booking → success screen with reference + PIN + Finish WhatsApp button. The confirmed booking then appears in the Mes réservations tab. Regression on Cars tab filters, Car details (Réserver + WhatsApp), and Settings language switch FR/EN/AR still works. Non-blocking: shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings still logged by web preview only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings on web preview: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking cosmetic RN 0.75+ migration.

action_items: (Optional polish) Migrate any remaining shadow*/pointerEvents style props to their non-deprecated equivalents (boxShadow / style.pointerEvents) to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _create_upstream_booking correctly separates CSRF-fetch (GET booking.php) from POST api/bookings.php using a shared requests.Session so PHPSESSID + csrf_token round-trip works.
Local Mongo insert now only happens when upstream success is true (`if not data.get('success'): raise HTTPException`). Fixes the DB-pollution issue flagged in iteration_1.
BookingCreate model correctly enforces required fields via Pydantic — verified that missing last_name/pickup_city returns 422 (not 500).
WhatsApp number is normalised (`re.sub('[^0-9]', ...)`) before being sent upstream — good defensive input cleanup.
Frontend Bookings tab reads from AsyncStorage (`bookingsStore.getBookings`) with `useFocusEffect`, so the created booking reliably appears after navigation.

rca_of_issue: The previous upstream failure (iteration_1) is fully resolved by switching from the /api/mobile_api.php?action=create_booking JSON endpoint to the website booking flow: GET https://airbcars.ma/booking.php?id={car_id} to obtain csrf_token + PHPSESSID cookie in a requests.Session, then POST form-urlencoded body (csrf_token, car_id, first_name, last_name, country_code, whatsapp, pickup_date, return_date, pickup_city, payment_method) to https://airbcars.ma/api/bookings.php. The server responds with {success:true, booking_number, pin_code, message} which the backend passes through unchanged.
